from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        star = operator.Star(worker_llm=self.llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=3,
            worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.MINESWEEPER_STAR_AGENT_1_PROMPT, prompt_custom.MINESWEEPER_STAR_AGENT_2_PROMPT, prompt_custom.MINESWEEPER_STAR_AGENT_3_PROMPT],
            aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.MINESWEEPER_STAR_AGG_PROMPT)
        draft = await star(problem)
        debate = operator.DebateWithModerator(worker_llm=self.aggregator_llm, moderator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, n_rounds=2,
            agent_prompts=[prompt_custom.MINESWEEPER_DEBATE_AGENT_1_PROMPT, prompt_custom.MINESWEEPER_DEBATE_AGENT_2_PROMPT],
            moderator_prompt=prompt_custom.MINESWEEPER_DEBATE_MODERATOR_PROMPT)
        solution = await debate(problem + "\n\nCandidate analysis from independent workers:\n" + (draft.get("response") or "```python\n[]\n```"))
        return solution.get("response") or '```python\n"Unable to determine any mine locations."\n```', {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta() or {},
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta() or {},
        }
